actions.detail: FOUND 2026-10-06 (operator question about Decarb Connect Europe): our input row said Hamburg, June 8-10, 2027, Verified (2027); the event's page says 14-15 April 2027, Vienna (Amsterdam was the 2022 edition). We measured the labels: of 213 input rows with a start date, 0 have a name year, EDITION and dates-text year that disagree; the database has 1 of 395. Another example found the same day: Nullcon Goa input deadline 11/30/2026 was the speaker-announcements date; the call closes 30 Oct 2026. Our year checks (Y1-Y4, start_date_arbiter) judge rows of a DELIVERY; the input list hints are never checked and they are what the research starts from. BUILD: a read-only audit that, for every row of Cybersecurity_input.csv and Utility_input.csv (about 220), reads the row's own pages (reuse scripts/shadow_reader.py and experiments/read_the_page_pass: page library, verbatim quote, year-aware: a 2026 date never proves 2027) and lists per field AGREES / DIFFERS (page states another value, with the quote) / UNSUPPORTED (the page states nothing for that edition). Output a CSV and a report. For DIFFERS and UNSUPPORTED hints propose the correction or the honest blank; the reviewer applies them to the input lists with backups. Also report which rows have id year != edition (frozen keys, by design) so a person is not misled. Rules: a quote on a page is not proof it answers the row's edition; check the date.
